svg.title: A payment reaches Dueline
svg.desc: The client pays on PayPal's own page. PayPal posts a signed webhook to Dueline. Dueline sends the raw body and headers back to PayPal's verify-webhook-signature API and goes on only when PayPal answers SUCCESS. It then reads the invoice from PayPal, looks up the capture and, if needed, Transaction Search for the real fee, net amount and rupees, stores those figures, refreshes the invoice snapshot and Home shows the rupees. A webhook that fails verification is refused, an event already processed is answered with 204, and a webhook that never arrives is made up by the morning run.

g.text: The client pays on PayPal's own page
PayPal posts a signed webhook to Dueline
Dueline has PayPal verify the signature on the exact body it received
Dueline reads the invoice from PayPal, the only source it trusts
It looks up the capture, then Transaction Search for the real fee and net
It stores the figures and refreshes the invoice snapshot
Home shows what reached the bank, in rupees
